title: Minimalist header — smoother edges and a complete switch

labels.after: Softer edges and full Terminal button

steps.headline: The Terminal button is whole; the controls fade toward the wallpaper instead of drawing a hard top line.
steps.changed: The switch no longer cuts off Terminal. The solid selection block is now a softer highlight, and the dark line along the session switcher is gone. The background fades at each control's edge.
steps.notice: The full-width header veil stays off; the wallpaper remains visible between controls.
